items.html: And now all three worlds — Beria, Yetzira, Assiya — are found entirely within Atzilut, and all of them are complete holiness. And the three worlds Beria, Yetzira, Assiya, which are thirty Sefirot, remained empty, an empty space, in the secret of the two-thousand-cubit Shabbat boundary. And the sixteen upper Sefirot were the Shabbat boundary, and the fourteen lower were a dwelling place for the Klipot, as above, and they are outside the boundary — understand this. And all these three aspects occurred then by themselves, not through the act of the lower beings, Adam and Eve.
